title: E2E D-toggle proof is manual-only: no automated assertion that ON/OFF captures differ, CI never executes the drive
detail: The PR's headline behavior (D toggles the panel in a real run) is verified only by human-inspected PNGs. The unit test pins intent-to-effect, but nothing machine-checks the rendered result; CI gate 8 compiles the e2e code without running it.
recommended_fix: Add an automated post-run assertion: pixel-compare bin/noc-e2e-on.png vs -off.png (panel rect must differ, rest identical), wired into a gate or run-dev.sh --e2e itself.

title: AC3 stream-neutrality proof (sidecar vs goldens/<demo>.t1) has no automated gate — the diff is human-run only
detail: The acceptance's byte-identity check is a manual `diff` command; no CI gate invokes overlay-check. Project testing rule: acceptance criteria become durable tests, not PR prose. Purity unit tests cover the mechanism, not the emitted stream.
recommended_fix: Add a harness.sh verb/gate: run bin/harness-debug overlay-check <demo> <ms>, then diff tail -n +7 of sidecar vs goldens/<demo>.t1, failing on mismatch.

title: noc_log_line bundle/pipe/lane resolution (map-wide, gone, lane lookup) has zero test coverage — compile-gated out of gate-2 tests
detail: The spec's edge-case matrix rows (stale slot renders "gone"; E22 rows show "map-wide") are real lookup logic with no durable test; gate 2 runs `odin test app/render` without PP_DEBUG, compiling this code out.
recommended_fix: Hoist noc_log_line above the PP_DEBUG gate (it is pure — no raylib calls) and add a @(test) pinning map-wide, gone, and lane-letter rows against a small topology/bundles fixture.

title: App-side rejection dedup latch is untested; same-tick same-kind double rejections undercount
detail: Only the feed-level noc_feed_reject is unit-tested. The latch condition treats (same tick, same kind) as not-new, so two distinct rejections of one kind in one tick count once; no test pins this boundary.
recommended_fix: Extract the latch as a pure helper (old tick/kind, new tick/kind) -> bool and @(test) transition, repeat, and same-tick-different-kind cases.

title: noc_panel_rows measure/draw agreement untested — stale sel_pipe counts 4 phantom rows, skewing the scroll clamp
detail: When pipe_slot fails (stale selection — the R2-N7 dead-pipe case), draw emits 0 rows but measure counted 4; scroll max overestimates, leaving blank scroll tail. No test pins measure == drawn rows.
recommended_fix: Count the sel_pipe section only when the pipe resolves (pass ok/stats-match into the measure), and add a @(test) comparing noc_panel_rows to a dry-run row count.

title: Queue-row predicate hardcodes 70 in measure and draw, untied to canon pipe_amber_pct and untested
detail: The row-selection threshold restates balance.json's 70 (ODN-5 numbers single-source) while bar colors derive from the catalog via the tested noc_level ladder; a canon change silently diverges row selection from colors.
recommended_fix: Thread amber_pct from the catalog into noc_queue_rows and the draw-side skip (mirroring noc_level), and pin the inclusion boundary with a @(test).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh gate 2: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/input -out:bin/input-test ..." (no PP_DEBUG define)
tools/ci-local.sh gate 8: "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug" (compile only, never run)
detail: P0 determinism ~100% (purity + incremental==one-shot @(test)s, gate-4 goldens; ON-leg stream proof manual). P1 D-toggle ~80-85%: intent chain unit-FULL, real-run render proof manual-only. P2 noc_log_line 0%. Overall ~85%.
recommended_fix: Automate the two manual proofs: a gate running overlay-check + sidecar diff vs goldens, and an e2e on/off capture pixel-assert; ungate pure helpers (noc_log_line) for unit tests. Raises P1 ≥90% → PASS.
